combat.fluxScaled.title: Volatile flux
stat.casualtiesSufferedByFighterPilotsLa: casualties suffered by fighter pilots launched from this ship
stat.chanceForShieldsToBePiercedByEmpArc: chance for shields to be pierced by EMP arcs
stat.chanceOfThisShipBreakingApartWhenDe: chance of this ship breaking apart when destroyed
stat.combatReadinessLossFromBeingInASola: combat readiness loss from being in a solar corona or a deep hyperspace storm
stat.damageDealtToMissilesByPointDefence: damage dealt to missiles by point defence weapons
stat.effectiveStrengthOfPlanetaryRaidsUp: effective strength of your fleet's planetary raids, up to the total number of marines in the fleet
stat.electronicWarfarePenaltyAgainstThis: electronic warfare penalty against this ship's weapon range
stat.hardFluxLevelForMinimumPhaseSpeed: hard flux level at which phased speed reaches its minimum
stat.heavyMachineryRequiredToPerformSurv: heavy machinery your fleet needs to perform surveys
stat.rangeFromWhichCombatObjectivesCanBe: range from which combat objectives can be captured
stat.rateAtWhichFighterReplacementCapabi: rate at which fighter replacement capability decays from losses
rate at which fighter replacement capability recovers
stat.rateOfCombatReadinessLossFromExtend: rate of combat readiness loss from extended deployment
stat.shieldSoftFluxConversion: shield damage converted to soft flux
stat.suppliesRequiredToPerformSurveysFle: supplies your fleet needs to perform surveys
effect.ZERO_FLUX_ALWAYS_ON: Allows the zero-flux speed boost to take effect regardless of flux level.
effect.ZERO_FLUX_BOOST_FLUX_LEVEL_PERCEN: The zero-flux speed boost also works while flux is at or below <good>{value}%</good>.
effect.SHIP_RECOVERY_CHANCE_BONUS: If disabled, this ship is almost always recoverable after the battle.
stat.armorDamageTakenPerDMod: armor damage taken per D-mod, up to 5 D-mods
effect.PD_IGNORES_DECOY_FLARES: Point-defense weapons can identify and ignore decoy flares.
effect.PD_BEST_TARGET_LEADING: Point-defense weapons get the best possible target leading, regardless of combat readiness.
effect.PD_RECLASSIFY_SMALL_WEAPONS: All small non-missile, non-strike weapons are classified as point-defense, automatically target missiles, and are affected by point-defense stat modifiers.
effect.BALLISTIC_COUNTS_AS_ENERGY: Ballistic weapons also gain this ship's energy weapon modifiers.
effect.BALLISTIC_SLOTS_HYBRID: Ballistic slots also accept energy weapons.
stat.commandPointRecoveryWhileFlagship: command point recovery rate while this ship is the flagship
stat.fluxRateOfFireAndAmmoRegenWhilePhas: flux dissipation, weapon rate of fire, and ammo regeneration while phased
effect.PHASE_ANCHOR_EMERGENCY_DIVE: While at risk of being destroyed or disabled, this ship can instead perform an emergency dive into phase space, retreating from battle and suffering an additional combat readiness penalty equal to {value}% of its deployment cost. The ship must have enough combat readiness to cover this cost. Only one ship per battle, regardless of side, can perform this dive.
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_SPLIT_TARGETS_FLAT.on: Beam weapon hits split their damage evenly across the target and up to {value} additional nearby enemy ship. Fighters are never chosen. The target acquisition range is half the beam weapon's range. Split beams also carry the weapon's special beam effects.
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_SPLIT_TARGETS_FLAT.ot: Beam weapon hits split their damage evenly across the target and up to {value} additional nearby enemy ships. Fighters are never chosen. The target acquisition range is half the beam weapon's range. Split beams also carry the weapon's special beam effects.
effect.EXPLODE_ON_DEATH: When this ship is destroyed, it detonates violently, dealing high-explosive damage equal to up to {value}% of its maximum fuel capacity to nearby ships, tapering off with distance.
effect.NON_BEAM_ENERGY_WEAPON_CHAIN_CHAN: Non-beam energy weapon hits that land on an enemy shield have a <good>{value}%</good> chance to refract: the same weapon fires a copy of the shot from that shield at the nearest other enemy ship within the weapon's range. A refracted shot that hits an enemy shield has the same chance to refract again.
effect.NON_BEAM_ENERGY_WEAPON_CHAIN_FALL: Each refraction deals <bad>{value}%</bad> less damage than the shot before it.
effect.BALLISTIC_WEAPON_PIERCE_CHANCE_PE: Ballistic projectile hits on an enemy ship's armor or hull have a <good>{value}%</good> chance to pierce. A pierced shot cannot pierce again.
effect.ESCORT_MANEUVER_BONUS_PERCENT: While within {range} su of a larger friendly ship, up to {value}% increased maneuverability, fading out over a further {fade} su. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.ESCORT_SPEED_BONUS_PERCENT: While within {range} su of a larger friendly ship, up to {value}% increased top speed, fading out over a further {fade} su. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.ESCORT_WEAPON_RANGE_BONUS_PERCENT: While within {range} su of a larger friendly ship, up to {value}% increased ballistic and energy weapon range, fading out over a further {fade} su. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.NANOFORGE_HULL_REGEN_PERCENT: After {seconds} seconds without taking hull damage, repairs {value}% of maximum hull per second in combat, up to {limit}% of maximum hull in total per deployment.
effect.DISINTEGRATION_ARMOR_DAMAGE_PERCE: Energy weapon hits on armor strip an additional {value}% of the hit's damage from the armor around the impact. This extra damage never reaches the hull.
effect.TERRIFYING_PRESENCE_ACCURACY_PENA: Enemy ships within {range} su have <good>-{value}%</good> to the target leading accuracy of their autofiring weapons. Penalties from several ships with this effect stack.
effect.NON_BEAM_WEAPON_DAMAGE_PER_SPEED_: <good>{value}%</good> increased ballistic and non-beam energy weapon damage for every su/s of the ship's current speed, with no cap.
effect.MEDIUM_ENERGY_SLOT_WEAPON_RANGE_F: <good>+{value}</good> to the base range of weapons in medium energy slots.
effect.SHIELD_ABSORB_RATE_OF_FIRE_PERCEN: Flux taken by the shield charges a reserve of up to {max}, which drains by {drain} per second. While charged, up to <good>{value}%</good> increased ballistic and energy weapon rate of fire, at full strength from {full} reserve. Non-beam weapons also pay less flux per shot, so their faster fire costs no extra flux.
effect.HEARTLESS_ON_NEARBY_DESTRUCTION_R: Whenever a non-fighter ship is destroyed within {value} su, this ship gains a Heartless stack until the end of combat. By default, ships can hold a maximum of {stacks} Heartless stacks.
effect.HEARTLESS_ARMOR_RESTORE_PERCENT: Gaining a Heartless stack restores <good>{value}%</good> of maximum armor to every armor cell.
effect.HEARTLESS_ARMOR_PERCENT_PER_STACK: Each Heartless stack grants <good>{value}%</good> more armor in every armor cell, above its normal maximum.
effect.HEARTLESS_MOBILITY_PENALTY_PERCEN: <bad>{value}%</bad> reduced top speed and maneuverability for each Heartless stack.
effect.HEARTLESS_RADIATION_EMP_FLAT: Each new Heartless stack sets off a radiation surge that deals <bad>{value}</bad> EMP damage to a random weapon and to a random engine on this ship.
effect.HEARTLESS_CREW_DEATH_CHANCE_PERCE: Each Heartless stack has a <bad>{value}%</bad> chance to sacrifice a crew member for each missile fired.
effect.HEARTLESS_MISSILE_DAMAGE_PERCENT_: <good>{value}%</good> increased missile damage for each Heartless stack while the fleet has crew left to give.
effect.HEARTLESS_MISSILE_SPEED_PERCENT_P: <good>{value}%</good> increased missile top speed for each Heartless stack while the fleet has crew left to give.
effect.SERAPHS_GRACE_MAX_STACKS_FLAT: Every {damage} armor and hull damage this ship takes grants a stack of Borrowed Grace lasting {duration} seconds, up to <good>{value}</good> stacks. Stack timers pause while the ship is phased.
effect.SERAPHS_GRACE_PERCENT_PER_STACK: Each Borrowed Grace stack grants <good>{value}%</good> increased top speed, flux dissipation and weapon rate of fire, and <good>{value}%</good> reduced weapon flux cost and damage taken.
effect.SERAPHIM_HEAL_PERCENT: Repairs hull equal to <good>{value}%</good> of the armor and hull damage this ship deals to enemy ships.
effect.SERAPHIM_HEAL_CAP_PERCENT: Seraph Hunting Routines repair at most <good>{value}%</good> of this ship's maximum hull per battle.
effect.SERAPHIM_DAMAGE_BONUS_PERCENT: Up to <good>{value}%</good> increased ballistic and energy weapon damage, building up as this ship deals armor and hull damage to enemy ships. At the full bonus, the zero-flux speed boost works at any flux level.
effect.SERAPHIM_FULL_BONUS_DAMAGE_FLAT: The full Seraph Hunting Routines damage bonus is reached after dealing {value} armor and hull damage.
effect.CREW_STEAL_RANGE_FLAT: Enemy ships destroyed within {value} su of this ship have their survivors pressed into service. Each wreck is only claimed once.
effect.DYNAMIC_GRID_ENERGY_WEAPON_BONUS_: Once shields have been down for {frigate}/{destroyer}/{cruiser}/{capital} seconds (frigate to capital) while not venting or overloaded, <good>{value}%</good> increased energy weapon rate of fire and <good>{value}%</good> reduced energy weapon flux cost.
effect.ION_ARC_CHANCE_PERCENT: Energy shots that hit an enemy shield can arc through to its hull, dealing {damage}% of the shot's damage plus {emp}% as EMP. The chance is <good>{value}%</good> when the target is at full hard flux and falls with its hard flux.
effect.GRAVITY_DRAG_TIMEFLOW_PERCENT: Enemy ships within {range} su have up to <good>{value}%</good> less timeflow, strongest at close range, or up to <good>{phased}%</good> less while this ship is phased. Gravitational drag from every source, including Nightcross's own Gravitational Drag hull mod, is capped at {cap}% per ship.
effect.TERMINAL_DESCENT_HULL_DAMAGE_TAKE: When its hull drops below {enter}% during a battle, the ship enters Terminal Descent until its hull is back above {leave}%. During Terminal Descent, <good>{value}%</good> reduced hull damage taken, but peak performance time stops so combat readiness drains, and venting is blocked.
effect.TERMINAL_DESCENT_FLUX_DISSIPATION: <good>{value}%</good> increased flux dissipation during Terminal Descent.
effect.TERMINAL_DESCENT_SYSTEM_REGEN_PER: <good>{value}%</good> increased ship system charge regeneration during Terminal Descent.
effect.TERMINAL_DESCENT_SHIELD_DAMAGE_TA: <bad>{value}%</bad> increased shield damage taken during Terminal Descent.
effect.MODULE_HULL_PERCENT: This ship's modules have <good>{value}%</good> increased hull points.
effect.MODULE_ARMOR_PERCENT: This ship's modules have <good>{value}%</good> increased armor.
effect.RISE_FROM_THE_ASHES_HULL_PERCENT: Once per battle, the hit that would destroy this ship instead leaves it with <good>{value}%</good> of its maximum hull points.
effect.RISE_FROM_THE_ASHES_ARMOR_RESTORE: Surviving that hit restores <good>{value}%</good> of maximum armor to every armor cell.
effect.RISE_FROM_THE_ASHES_DAMAGE_TAKEN_: <good>{value}%</good> less damage taken for {seconds} seconds after surviving that hit.
<bad>{value}%</bad> more damage taken for {seconds} seconds after surviving that hit.
effect.THERMO_ACCELERATOR_FLUX_COST_REDU: Turret weapons have <good>{value}%</good> reduced flux cost. Hardpoint weapons can't fire.
effect.SOLARIS_OVERDRIVE_SECONDS_FLAT: Weapons cost no flux to fire for <good>{value}</good> seconds after this ship's system activates, at most once every {cooldown} seconds.
effect.SOLARIS_OVERDRIVE_PROJECTILE_SPEE: <good>{value}%</good> increased weapon projectile speed for those seconds.
effect.FUROR_RATE_OF_FIRE_PERCENT: Damage dealt to enemy ships builds fury, granting up to <good>{value}%</good> increased weapon rate of fire, full after {frigate}/{destroyer}/{cruiser}/{capital} damage (frigate to capital). Shield hits count at half, EMP at a quarter. Fury fades by {decay}% per second.
effect.MALFUNCTION_AURA_PERCENT: Enemy ships within {range} su have a <good>{value}%</good> chance of weapon malfunctions. Several ships with this effect don't stack; the strongest applies.
effect.REPAIR_COORDINATOR_ARMOR_PERCENT: Repairs the armor of the closest damaged allied ship within {range} su by <good>{value}%</good> of its total armor per second. Each ship with this effect restores at most {perShip}% of any one ally's armor per battle, and each ally regains at most {limit}% in total from all of them. Pauses while overloaded or venting.
effect.WING_SCRAMBLE_COPIES: When this ship deploys, its wings that share a role (fighter, bomber, interceptor or support) lend each other fighters. Each wing keeps at least 1 of its own fighters and fills the rest of its normal wing size with up to <good>{value}</good> of every other fighter type in its group. All its wings use the engagement range of its longest-ranged wing. Fighters in each group fly at the group's average top speed.
effect.FIGHTER_WING_SHARED_DAMAGE_PERCEN: When a fighter launched from this ship takes a hit smaller than its max hull or flux, <good>{value}%</good> of that damage is shared across its wing, however far apart they fly: hull damage between their hulls and shield damage between the flux pools of wingmates with shields raised. Phased, docking and launching wingmates, and any whose max hull or flux is smaller than the whole hit, are left out, and shared flux never overloads a wingmate.
effect.FIGHTER_WING_DAMAGE_TAKEN_PERCENT: Fighters launched from this ship take <good>{value}%</good> less damage for every living fighter of their wing out in space (not docked, landing or launching), up to {max}% less.
effect.CORROSION_MOTE_DAMAGE_FLAT: Every {seconds} seconds a beam weapon spends on an enemy ship's armor or hull, it launches a homing stardust mote at the target dealing <good>{value}</good> energy damage and <good>{value}</good> EMP. At most {max} of this ship's motes fly at once.
effect.CREW_STEAL_SKELETON_CREW_PERCENT: Takes <good>{value}%</good> of each such wreck's skeleton crew. They can feed Live Munitions straight away; after combat, win or lose, the rest join your fleet if there is room.
effect.FLUX_SCALED_TOP_SPEED_FLAT: Top speed changes with flux, from <good>+{value}</good> su/s at no flux to <bad>-{value}</bad> su/s at full flux, with no change at half flux. Below half flux, also up to <good>{value}%</good> increased acceleration and turn acceleration.
effect.FLUX_SCALED_RATE_OF_FIRE_PERCENT: Weapon rate of fire changes with flux, from <good>{value}%</good> increased at no flux to <bad>{value}%</bad> reduced at full flux, with no change at half flux. Venting or being overloaded counts as full flux.
effect.FLUX_CAPACITOR_EFFECTIVENESS_PERC: <good>{value}%</good> increased flux capacity granted by each flux capacitor.
effect.AUGMENTED_FLUX_SCALED_PENALTY_RED: On hulls with Augmented Systems, <good>{value}%</good> reduced effect of the high-flux top speed and rate of fire penalties.
effect.AUGMENTED_INERTIAL_PROJECTILE_SPE: On hulls with Augmented Systems, also grants increased projectile speed equal to <good>{value}%</good> of the speed-based damage bonus.
effect.AUGMENTED_SYSTEM_REGEN_PERCENT: On hulls with Augmented Systems, <good>{value}%</good> increased ship system charge regeneration.
effect.FIGHTER_BAYS_FLAT.warning: Unallocating it returns any fighter wing in the bay it adds to your cargo.
effect.CONVERTED_HANGAR_FIGHTER_BAYS_FLA: <good>+{value}</good> to number of fighter bays, plus any extra bays from Vast Hangar.
effect.FIGHTER_REPLACEMENT_RATE_MULT.slo: <bad>{value}%</bad> slower fighter replacement rate decay and recovery.
effect.FIGHTER_REPLACEMENT_RATE_MULT.fas: <good>{value}%</good> faster fighter replacement rate decay and recovery.
effect.FIGHTER_FOCUS_FIRE_DAMAGE_PERCENT: Each hit by a fighter launched from this ship marks the enemy ship it hits, which then takes <good>{value}%</good> increased damage from this ship's fighters for each mark. The marks clear {reset} seconds after the last hit. Each second of beam contact counts as one hit.
effect.FIGHTER_FOCUS_FIRE_MAX_DAMAGE_PER: Fighter marks grant up to a maximum of <good>{value}%</good> increased damage taken.
effect.BOMBER_PAYLOAD_DETONATION_CHANCE_: Every {interval} seconds, each bomber launched from this ship that still carries any payload has a <bad>{value}%</bad> chance to set off one full salvo from every loaded weapon at once, destroying itself and damaging every ship nearby, friend or foe. Weapons that regenerate ammunition count as loaded only while the bomber still carries its other ordnance, or when they are all it carries. Bombers within {distance} units of this ship's hull never detonate.
stat.damageToCapitalShips: damage to capital ships and stations
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_HARD_FLUX_PERCENT: <good>{value}%</good> of beam weapon damage dealt to shields is dealt as hard flux.
effect.SHIELD_DAMAGE_SHARED_PERCENT: Disperses {value}% of shield damage taken to nearby allied ships within {range} su that aren't overloaded or venting, split evenly between them as hard flux.
effect.SHIELD_SOFT_FLUX_CONVERSION_PERCE: <good>{value}%</good> of shield damage taken is converted to soft flux.
effect.PHASE_FIELD_CONTRIBUTION_PERCENT: Even if this ship isn't a phase ship, {value}% of its sensor strength counts toward the fleet-wide reduction in detected-at range that phase ships normally provide (see the Phase Field hull mod). Every contributing ship, and stronger sensors, make your fleet harder to detect, with diminishing returns. Only applies while your fleet's transponder is off.
effect.SENSOR_STRENGTH_ALWAYS_COUNTS: This ship's sensor strength always contributes to fleet-wide sensor strength.
fleet.sensorStrengthAlwaysCounts: Ships whose sensor strength always counts
stat.weaponDamagePerDMod: weapon damage per D-mod, up to 5 D-mods
stat.topSpeedPerDMod: top speed per D-mod, up to 5 D-mods
stat.negativeEffectsFromDModsPerDMod: negative effects from D-mods per D-mod, up to 5 D-mods
stat.negativeEffectsFromLogisticsDModsPe: negative effects from logistics D-mods per D-mod, up to 5 D-mods
stat.negativeEffectsFromNonLogisticsDMod: negative effects from combat D-mods per D-mod, up to 5 D-mods
effect.GROUND_SUPPORT_PER_MAX_CREW_PERCE: Your fleet gains effective planetary raid strength equal to <good>{value}%</good> of this ship's maximum crew capacity (after modifiers), up to the total number of marines in the fleet.
effect.BALLISTIC_WEAPON_DAMAGE_PER_BURN_: <good>{value}%</good> more ballistic weapon damage for every burn level this ship has above its hull's default, from any source.
effect.MISSILE_RELOAD_PERCENT_PER_MINUTE: Missile weapons that cannot regenerate ammo reload <good>{value}%</good> of their base ammo every minute in combat.
effect.ENERGY_WEAPON_RANGE_PER_SENSOR_ST: <good>+{value}</good> to energy weapon range for every point of this ship's sensor strength (after modifiers).
effect.ARMOR_FLAT_FOR_LOW_BASE_ARMOR: Up to <good>+{most}</good> to armor. The bonus is highest on hulls with the least base armor and falls to <good>+{least}</good> at <hl>{cutoff}</hl> base armor (frigate/destroyer/cruiser/capital ship). Can't be allocated on phase ships or on hulls with more base armor than that.
effect.ARMOR_FLAT_FOR_LOW_BASE_ARMOR.hul: Up to <good>+{most}</good> to armor. The bonus is highest on hulls with the least base armor and falls to <good>+{least}</good> at <hl>{cutoff}</hl> base armor. Can't be allocated on phase ships or on hulls with more base armor than that.
effect.REPAIR_TIME_MULT.reduces: <good>{value}%</good> less weapon and engine repair time.
effect.REPAIR_TIME_MULT.increases: <bad>{value}%</bad> more weapon and engine repair time.
stat.minimumCrewRequiredPerFighterBay: minimum crew required per fighter bay
stat.minimumCrewRequiredPerFighterBayCap: minimum crew required per fighter bay (capped at -80% total)
stat.postBattleSalvageRecoveredFleetWide: post-battle salvage recovered by your fleet
effect.REMOVE_CIVILIAN_HULL_PENALTY: Removes the penalties of a civilian-grade hull.
effect.CREATE_FRONT_SHIELD_IF_NONE: Installs a makeshift, front-facing shield if this ship has none.
effect.CONVERT_SHIELD_TO_FRONT: Converts this ship's shield to front-facing.
effect.CONVERT_SHIELD_TO_OMNI: Converts this ship's shield to omni-directional.
effect.DEATH_ON_COLLISION: Touching another ship's hull, however slightly, is instantly fatal to this ship. Fighters, wrecks and asteroids don't count.
effect.RAM_BIGGEST_ENEMY: When this ship isn't flown by you, it flies straight at the biggest enemy ship, intent on colliding.
stat.damageDealtByFightersLaunchedFromTh: damage dealt by fighters launched from this ship to other fighters and missiles
stat.fighterRelaunchTimeAsAOfBaseRefitTi: fighter relaunch time, as a % of base refit time
effect.REMOVE_ALL_FIGHTER_BAYS: Removes all of this ship's fighter bays.
stat.ordnancePointCostOfLargeBallisticWe: ordnance point cost of large ballistic weapons
weapon.stat.RANGE_FALLOFF: weapon range beyond the range threshold
weapon.stat.AUTOFIRE_ACCURACY: target leading accuracy of autofiring weapons
weapon.stat.ECCM_CHANCE: chance for missiles to resist enemy ECM and flares
weapon.note.burstBeam: Burst beams instead recharge faster between bursts.
weapon.note.perWeapon: This is set directly on each weapon: it's correct in combat, but the refit screen's weapon tooltips won't show it.
node.requires.req_non_phase_hull: Can't be allocated on phase ships.
node.block.lowBaseArmor: Requires a non-phase hull with low base armor.
modifier.phaseSensorNetworks: Phase ships and phase sensor networks in fleet
combat.terminalDescent.status: less hull damage taken, venting blocked
